big: A client buys silver after a record year. Months later, she is down about 50%. To recover from a 50% fall, she needs a 100% gain. Silver is also a smaller market than gold, so it swings far more.

lines: Why not buy what just rallied?

Because buying near the top can lead to deep losses, and a 50% fall needs a 100% gain to recover. Precious metals belong as diversifiers in measured amounts, not as the main return engine, and not because they just rallied. Check the client understands the downside first.
